title: ConnectionsSetHostModeResult
description: Result of the connections.setHostMode JSON-RPC method: the method now in force for the connection's host. A record that could not be persisted is not a result — the call answers an error whose message is the reason the connection editor shows under the field (“Not saved: {reason}”), and nothing about the host changes, so the editor's Save can be retried.

profileId.description: The connection the write was made for.

mode.description: The method in force after the call.
